remarks: Found in the attic of a farmhouse in Czechoslovakia in 1971. Restored to playing condition. Kliment assigns the instrument to Johann Leonhard Ehe I on the basis of details of construction, by comparison with an instrument in Grassi Museum, Leipzig. Tubular slide-stays, moveable one telescopic. Slide-bow has bumper-guard (flange). Ring in bell-bow, mounted on saddle. Ferrules have ring pattern; some ferrules have toothed crown on one end. Flat bell-stay with eyelet, hinge, pin. Considerable terminal flare in bell. Replica made by Bohumil Beníček
